Printing is blocked here

Preview windows (the Claude app, email attachments, Google Drive or a file viewer) block printing. WillChart itself is fine.

  1. Download or save the WillChart file to the computer.
  2. Double-click it so it opens in Chrome or Edge (the address bar will start with file://).
  3. Press Print again.

Charting saved in a preview window stays in that preview. Start the sim in the browser copy.

Reset charting for the next group?
